scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:viewer && npm run build:sandbox-types
scripts.verify:extension: npm run build:extension && npm run test:extension && npm run verify --workspace @manifold3d/copilot-extension
scripts.extension:install: npm run build:extension && npm run install:local --workspace @manifold3d/copilot-extension
scripts.release:check: npm run check:sync && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.plugin:copilot:install: npm run build && copilot plugin install ./plugin
scripts.mcp: npm run -s build:viewer && npm run -s build:server && npm run -s build:sandbox-types && node packages/manifold3d-mcp/dist/server/index.js
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/protocol packages/modeling packages/viewer-host packages/manifold3d-mcp && tsc -p packages/viewer/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/copilot-extension/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p samples/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tests/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run -s build && npm run -s test:unit:built && npm run -s test:smoke:built
scripts.test:unit: npm run -s build && npm run -s test:unit:built
scripts.test:smoke: npm run -s build && npm run -s test:smoke:built
scripts.test:watch: npm run -s build && node scripts/run-vitest.mjs --watch --dir tests --exclude=**/smoke.test.ts
